citation: ICMR-NIN Expert Group, Nutrient Requirements for Indians — Recommended Dietary Allowances (RDA) and Estimated Average Requirements (EAR), 2020. Per-rule table and page are recorded in each rule's own notes.
notes: Generated by `npm run nutrition:extract-rda` from the publication's own text, not typed by hand. The extractor cross-checks every figure against the ICMR-NIN Brief Note's summary tables (Tables 3 and 4) and refuses to write the file if any disagrees. Adults only: 19-130 y, male and female. Children, adolescents, pregnancy and lactation are deliberately out of scope — see the script's header for why.
